(rule!
 ;; Remove the modal background. Trace the induced four-neighbor path from
 ;; the reading-order-first endpoint, preserving every cell and repeated run.
 ;; Canonical output is a vertical column in path order, not spatial order.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define mode 0)
   (define rival 0)
   (define bg (pick-max (grid-colors g) (lambda (v) (count-color g v))))
   (define fg (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))) (grid-positions g)))
   (define (neighbors p)
    (filter (lambda (q) (and (in-bounds? (first q) (second q) h w)
                             (not (= (at g (first q) (second q)) bg))))
            (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)))
   (define ends (filter (lambda (p) (= (length (neighbors p)) 1)) fg))
   (define (walk p previous remaining)
    (if (= remaining 0) '()
        (let ((next (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q previous))) (neighbors p))))
         (cons (at g (first p) (second p))
               (if (null? next) '() (walk (first next) p (- remaining 1)))))))
   (define traced (walk (first ends) #f (length fg)))
   (define colors
    (cond ((= rival 2) (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) fg))
          ((= rival 3) (apply append (map (lambda (o) (make-list (obj-size o) (obj-color o))) (objects g bg))))
          ((= rival 4) (reverse traced))
          ((= rival 5) (sort traced <))
          ((= rival 6) (apply append (map (lambda (v) (make-list (count-if (lambda (x) (= x v)) traced) v)) (remove-duplicates traced))))
          (else traced)))
   (define runs
    (reverse
     (for/fold ((acc '())) ((v colors))
      (if (and (pair? acc) (= v (first (first acc))))
          (cons (cons v (first acc)) (rest acc))
          (cons (list v) acc)))))
   (define k (length (first runs)))
   (define candidates (rest runs))
   (define selected-index (modulo (- k 1) (length candidates)))
   (define answer
    (cond ((= rival 7) (first candidates))
          ((= rival 8) (last candidates))
          ((= rival 9) (pick-max candidates length))
          ((= rival 10) (pick-min candidates length))
          ((= rival 11) (list-ref candidates (modulo k (length candidates))))
          ((= rival 12) (first runs))
          ((= mode 0) colors)
          (else (list-ref candidates selected-index))))
   (map (lambda (v) (list v)) answer))))

(rule!
 ;; The modal background surrounds one nonbranching four-neighbor colored path.
 ;; Start at the row-major smaller endpoint, follow the path through its bends,
 ;; and put each visited color in the next row of a one-column output. Repeated
 ;; colors remain in their original path positions, not pooled into a histogram.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define cells (for*/list ((r (range (rows g))) (c (range (cols g)))
                            #:when (not (= (at g r c) bg))) (list r c)))
   (define (adjacent? p q)
    (= (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q)))) 1))
   (define (neighbors p) (filter (lambda (q) (adjacent? p q)) cells))
   (define endpoints (filter (lambda (p) (= (length (neighbors p)) 1)) cells))
   (define route
    (let walk ((p (first endpoints)) (seen '()))
     (define next (filter (lambda (q) (not (member q seen))) (neighbors p)))
     (cons p (if (null? next) '() (walk (first next) (cons p seen))))))
   (define trace-mode 'path)
   (define ordered
    (cond ((equal? trace-mode 'row_major) cells)
          ((equal? trace-mode 'column_major)
           (sort cells (lambda (p q) (< (+ (* (second p) (rows g)) (first p))
                                       (+ (* (second q) (rows g)) (first q))))))
          ((equal? trace-mode 'reverse) (reverse route))
          (else route)))
   (define raw-sequence (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) ordered))
   (define sequence (if (equal? trace-mode 'histogram) (sort raw-sequence <) raw-sequence))
   (define runs
    (let group ((remaining sequence) (current '()) (done '()))
     (cond ((null? remaining) (reverse (if (null? current) done (cons current done))))
           ((or (null? current) (= (first remaining) (first current)))
            (group (rest remaining) (cons (first remaining) current) done))
           (else (group (rest remaining) (list (first remaining)) (cons current done))))))
   (define finish 'length_addressed_run)
   (define selector 'header)
   (define paint-mode 'run)
   (define address
    (cond ((number? selector) selector)
          ((equal? selector 'last) (- (length runs) 1))
          ((equal? selector 'largest)
           (if (> (length runs) 1)
             (first (sort (range 1 (length runs))
                      (lambda (i j) (> (length (nth runs i)) (length (nth runs j)))))) 0))
          (else (length (first runs)))))
   (define selected-color (if (< address (length runs)) (first (nth runs address)) -1))
   (if (equal? finish 'unroll)
       (map list sequence)
       (apply append
        (for/list ((run runs) (i (range (length runs))))
         (for/list ((color run))
          (list (if (or (= i address)
                        (and (equal? paint-mode 'all_matching) (= color selected-color))) 9 color)))))))))
